chat_line.note: All-inclusive for agents hosted on bitHuman (ImagineX): it covers the avatar, rendered in our cloud or in the viewer's browser, so a hosted chat session has no separate avatar charge (essence-1, essence-2, expression-1, expression-2).

camera_chat_line.note: The chat line's rate when the agent's camera (vision) chat is on: it replaces chat_line for that session and is likewise all-inclusive.

in_browser.note: An avatar-only session (your own agent through the plugin or the API) that renders in the viewer's browser bills the model's self_hosted rate above; inside a hosted chat session the chat line covers it. A model with no self_hosted rate does not render in the browser.

realtime.note: Live sessions bill active session time, talking or idle, to the exact second. `rounding` and `basis` state the rule in force right now for each rate. Authoritative charges are made server-side; this is a reference, never lower than the debit.
